billboard on Instagram: "RM of BTS has suffered an ankle injury just a couple days before the group's long-awaited comeback concert in Seoul.⁠
⁠
Big Hit Entertainment shared that the incident happened during a rehearsal for the performance on March 19, "and was taken to a hospital to undergo a detailed examination and treatment,” it read. His diagnosis confirmed a partial ligament tear and a talus contusion" and he will need to wear a cast for at least two weeks until he recovers. His onstage performances will be “partially limited” in the meantime.⁠
⁠
More details ahead of their first live show in years, set for Saturday (March 21) at Gwanghwamun Square, are at the link in bio."
